fieldData.description: To celebrate the 1 year anniversary of Radix mainnet launch, come share drink with your fellow Indian community members and chat about crypto, DeFi, and of course RadixDLT! This event will be very casual and welcoming. Anyone who wants to make friends and learn about DeFi is welcome. Feel free to reach out to @inam_hasan on Telegram for any clarification and join India community https://t.me/radix_india
